chapters.title: Intern each subtree as an integer id

frames.caption: Intern each subtree as an integer id — O(n) time, O(n) extra space. Input: find_duplicate_subtrees(root=tree (1)). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
uid = ids.setdefault(triple, len(ids) + 1) — ids[(2, 3, 1)] = 3; node moves to (3); triple is now (2, 3, 1); uid = 3
uid = ids.setdefault(triple, len(ids) + 1) — ids[(2, 1, 3)] = 4; node moves to (1); swap triple[1] and triple[2]; uid = 4
